% All generated figures, tables and prompts of the paper, without captions.
% reproduce.sh compiles this file to out/figures.pdf. The inputs come from out/inputs/.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}
\usepackage[textwidth=5.5in, textheight=9in]{geometry}  % the text width of the paper
\usepackage[table]{xcolor}
\usepackage{amsmath}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usepackage{booktabs}
\usepackage{placeins}
\usepackage{tcolorbox}
\tcbuselibrary{listings, breakable, most}

% The generated files use \1C for a rubric.
\def\1#1{\mathcal{#1}}

% The prompt listings. This is the same definition as in the paper.
\newtcblisting{textbox}[2][gray!60!black]{%
	enhanced,
	breakable,
	listing only,
	listing options={
			basicstyle = \small\ttfamily,
			breaklines = true,
			breakatwhitespace = true,
			columns = fullflexible,
			extendedchars = true,
			literate = {—}{{---}}3 {–}{{--}}2 {‘}{{`}}1 {’}{{'}}1
				{“}{{``}}2 {”}{{''}}2 {…}{{...}}3 {≥}{{>=}}2 {≤}{{<=}}2,
		},
	colback       = gray!4!white,
	colframe      = gray!40!black,
	colbacktitle  = #1,
	coltitle      = white,
	boxrule       = 0.4pt,
	arc           = 2pt,
	left=8pt, right=8pt, top=6pt, bottom=6pt,
	fonttitle     = \bfseries\small\sffamily,
	title         = {#2},
	attach boxed title to top left = {yshift=-2mm, xshift=6mm},
	boxed title style = {arc=2pt, boxrule=0pt},
}

% The paths are the same as in the paper: inputs/figures/..., inputs/tables/..., inputs/prompts/...
\makeatletter
\def\input@path{{out/}}
\makeatother

% The generated floats have an empty \caption{}. Here the caption of each float is its file name. The number in the name is its number in the paper.
\let\originalcaption\caption
\newcommand{\generated}[1]{\renewcommand{\caption}[2][]{\originalcaption{\texttt{\detokenize{#1}}}}\input{inputs/#1}\FloatBarrier}
